originals.ko: 나는 그걸 그에게 주고 싶지 않아
originals.why: The Welsh is natural, but it never uses the LEGO 'dw i ddim isio fo' (I don't want it). Here isio takes the verbnoun rhoi and fo is the object of rhoi, so this row practises 'don't want to give', not 'don't want it'.

originals.ko: 나는 화요일에 그걸 그에게 주고 싶지 않아
originals.why: Same problem as o1: the Welsh is natural, but fo belongs to rhoi, so 'dw i ddim isio fo' in the sense 'I don't want it' is not present.

originals.ko: 미안해 하지만 나는 그걸 그에게 주고 싶지 않아
originals.why: The Welsh is natural, but it is 'dw i ddim isio rhoi o iddo fo', so the LEGO 'dw i ddim isio fo' in the sense 'I don't want it' is not present.
